tspan.tspan: 損壞、版本不符或儲存不可

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 展示者：開啟或重新整理展示頁面

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 載入正常起點：六項預填、服務費未付、提案為草稿

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 還原已保存角色及需求、付款、履約、退款退回與分潤紀錄

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 顯示可理解的恢復提示，不靜默覆寫；等待展示者確認重設

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 顯示目前角色、訂單進度、待辦與可追溯操作紀錄

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保留共用資料，顯示該角色可執行的操作；回圖一至四

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：告知將取代目前展示資料，要求確認

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 不替換資料；維持目前畫面或恢復提示

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 清空前次情境資料；回圖一從六項表單開始

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 六項預填、服務費未付、可套用提案草稿；回圖一

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 已付服務費、兩提案已提交且已選定、尚未配送；回圖二安排確認

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 含前置紀錄、已配送並由餐廳收貨、尚未驗齡及支付酒款；回圖二驗齡

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 經共用轉換規則建立一致快照，僅替換本應用儲存資料；保存通過圖六才算成功

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 新情境不殘留前次付款、退款退回或分潤；重新整理後仍為此情境
